issue.title: [Transform] improve update API

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
rewrite config on update if either version is outdated, credentials change, the
update changes the config or deprecated settings are found. Deprecated settings
get migrated to the new format. The upgrade can be easily extended to do any
necessary re-writes.

fixes #56499

Note:

This change makes major version upgrades easier once we need them (`7.x` -> `8.0`).
